R381.note: Switches to Tika.detect(Path) for real content-based MIME detection; allowlist and reject/delete flow unchanged.

R382.note: Replaces Markup(label) with escape(label); output still rendered the same way, now HTML-escaped.

R383.note: Prepared statement with bound placeholder; error handling and return shape preserved exactly.

R384.note: Column-name allowlist for the ORDER/WHERE field with safe fallback to 'name'; term stays bound. Field allowlist values are inferred (no schema present) but consistent with the stated contract.

R385.note: resolve_entities=False is lxml's standard, sufficient fix for this pattern; no other behavior touched.

R386.note: Checks verify()'s boolean return and throws on failure before claims are read; correct Nimbus JOSE API.

R387.note: Eliminates the shell entirely via System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping, closing the injection; but this silently changes the response body format from PowerShell Test-Connection table output to a different plain-text format, and the validation condition (IsNullOrWhiteSpace OR !Unknown) is inverted so an empty serverName still enters the ping branch instead of being rejected.

R388.note: Stores using detected.ext from the magic-byte-verified type instead of the client extension; response shape unchanged.

R389.note: Validates replyTo/recipient for CRLF before MAIL FROM/RCPT TO, but envelope.getSubjectLine() (also attacker-controlled via the 'subject' request parameter) is still concatenated unvalidated into the DATA section in the same rewritten method, letting an attacker inject '\r\n.\r\n' to end DATA early and smuggle arbitrary follow-on SMTP commands on the same connection - the same CWE-77 class left open one line down from the fix.

R390.note: SqlParameter/AddWithValue replaces concatenation; apostrophes in actor now bind as literal data, count/JSON shape unchanged.

R391.note: UUID-based filename keyed off the detected (validated) MIME type; response still returns {url}, 400 path untouched.

R392.note: `.WithAntiforgeryToken()` is not a real ASP.NET Core extension method (does not compile). Even corrected, ASP.NET Core's minimal-API antiforgery auto-validation only covers IFormFile-bound parameters, not a JSON body like EmailChangeRequest, so app.UseAntiforgery() alone would not protect this endpoint anyway - a manual IAntiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync() call is needed.

R393.note: Magic-byte checks for PNG/JPEG match the existing two-entry allowlist and are inserted before the copy; storedName/response logic untouched.

R394.note: Adds Secure:true to the cookie; nothing else in the handler changes.

R395.note: SimpleEvaluationContext.forReadOnlyDataBinding() blocks method calls/constructors/type refs/bean access exactly as the contract requires while still permitting property reads on OrderContext.

R396.note: Moves the session write to after login_user() succeeds; same key/value, same redirect, only reachable once authenticated.

R397.note: allowed_classes=>false is presented as the primary fix, but with it every legitimate serialized ShoppingCart becomes a __PHP_Incomplete_Class, fails the existing instanceof check, and restoreCartFromCookie() silently discards every real saved cart, resetting it to empty on every visit. The safe whitelist form (allowed_classes=>['ShoppingCart']) that avoids this is offered only as an aside, not as the recommended fix.

R398.note: Moves the %wildcards% into the bound parameter instead of the query text; LIKE substring semantics preserved for any term including quotes/wildcards.

R399.note: RandomNumberGenerator replaces the seeded Random; correctly closes CWE-338. Minor: the code still declares an unused `int seed` query parameter the explanation says should be removed, but this doesn't change caller-facing behavior since seed was already required before.

R400.note: noent:false/dtdload:false is libxmljs's documented safe XXE configuration (blocks entity substitution and external DTD loading); orderId extraction for legitimate XML unaffected.

R401.note: secure_filename() plus an extension allowlist matching the existing content-type allowlist, with a UUID prefix disclosed as part of the fix; response shape unchanged.

R402.note: Gate::authorize() is Laravel's standard exception-throwing enforcement call, correctly gating the update before it runs.

R403.note: Host-based allowlist check correctly blocks external/scheme-relative redirects; fallback to /home for unlisted relative paths is stated openly rather than silent.

R404.note: Encoder escapes CR/LF/control chars and Unicode line separators before logging; only the log line's content changes, which is the intended fix.

R405.note: Sort allowlist including the existing default ('created_at desc'); account_id/range binding untouched, matching the stated contract.

R406.note: Moves the email route from apiMux to protectedMux, mirroring the already-protected profile route; handler's own 405/202 logic untouched.

R407.note: PBKDF2-SHA256 key derivation plus AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption replaces the MD5-derived, unauthenticated CBC cipher. Response now also returns salt/iv/authTag, but this is stated openly as required for later decryption and only adds fields.

R408.note: crypto/rand.Text() is a real Go 1.24+ API for exactly this use; sessionID structure (username-token) is preserved, just with a strong token.

R409.note: Swapping text/template for html/template is the correct, minimal, standard Go fix; API surface used by the file is identical so no other changes are needed.

R410.note: %15s closes the stack overflow, but the stated contract requires an oversized token to be rejected (return -1), not truncated; scanf("%15s", code) silently keeps only the first 15 characters and returns success, so an over-length ticket code is silently accepted as a different, truncated value instead of being rejected - not disclosed anywhere in the write-up.

R411.note: Same host-allowlist pattern as R403, here rejecting (rather than falling back) for non-allowlisted paths, and stating that choice openly.

R412.note: IsAuthenticated + IsOwnerOrReadOnly + get_queryset filtering correctly close read/update/delete access to non-owners, but the serializer still exposes 'owner' as a writable field and perform_create() is not overridden, so an authenticated attacker can still POST an ApiKey with an arbitrary owner id - the same missing-authorization class re-opened via create.

R413.note: Primary fix (reject when offset+length>size) matches the stated contract and the existing offset-only-reject convention. A second 'alternative' clamp-and-truncate snippet is also offered without flagging that it violates the same contract's no-silent-truncation requirement, but it is not the recommended fix.

R414.note: Adds an admin-role check on the real caller.Role field between authentication and the suspend call; 401/403 split is correct and nothing else in the handler changes.

R415.note: Standard erase()-returns-next-iterator pattern; order and completeness of the removal are preserved as required.

R416.note: shared_ptr/enable_shared_from_this correctly extends Widget's lifetime past the queued lambda; call site changes are shown and consistent, output (lastFiredId) unaffected.

R417.note: Adds an offset/length bounds check before subspan(); returns an empty vector for invalid headers instead of reading out of bounds.

R418.note: Wraps the export route with requireAdmin, exactly mirroring the pattern already used for ban/unban.

R419.note: Allowlist regex on reportName blocks batch/cmd.exe metacharacters before it reaches ProcessBuilder; normal report identifiers still pass.

R420.note: Gate::authorize('delete', $order) matches the existing OrderPolicy::delete() ability and mirrors the show()/update() pattern already in the controller.
